title: Engine refusals of capture frames are counted but never shown
trigger: Join a call where the engine rejects external frames (qc_external_frame error, e.g. after the transport drops): every frame fails.
effect: FeederStats::failed/rejected/last_error are read nowhere outside tests (only stats().sent() is used), so the microphone or screen share looks live while nothing reaches the call; the failure is only an eprintln once a second. last_error is also never cleared after recovery.
fix: Have the driver poll the stats and turn a run of failures into CaptureEvent::Failed / an ActiveCapture error stage.

title: A start that times out leaves the SCStream possibly capturing with no owner
trigger: Start a screen share while macOS is slow to answer startCapture (over 5 s)
effect: recv_timeout fails and start returns Err, but stopCapture is never called and the stream is only dropped; if the handler fires late the system may keep the stream and the recording indicator on while Quill shows the share as failed
fix: On the timeout and error arms call stream.stopCaptureWithCompletionHandler(None) and mark StreamShared stopped before returning.

title: A lost output device silently ends system audio while the call still says it is sharing it
trigger: Share a screen with system audio on Windows, then unplug headphones or change the default output
effect: The error callback calls StreamErrors::check and discards the Fatal result; the stream goes dead, the mix queue drains, and CallScreen::sharing_audio() stays true with no event or toast
fix: Report a fatal stream error back to the opener (a channel or DeviceRun::Failed) so SharedAudio leaves its running stage and the UI shows audio off.

title: connect_group marks the call connected before its fallible steps, so a retry reports success without finishing the join
trigger: Join a voice chat with the camera on while the camera cannot be opened (in use by another app or unplugged), or while qc_group_set_requested_video refuses the sources. connect_group sets connected=true, then apply_group_camera/sync_group_videos returns Err. connect/group_calls/mod.rs:157 stores transport_error and leaves transport_ready false; on the next poll it calls connect_group_call again.
effect: The second call hits `if call.connected { return Ok(()) }`, so the driver sets transport_ready=true, clears transport_error and records group_camera_state=Some(camera). The UI shows camera on and no error while the engine never opened the camera (and the mute/video setup after the failed step never ran).
fix: Make the join a typestate (Created, Joining, Connected{mode}) and enter Connected only after every step succeeded, or run the steps first and flip the stage last; a failed step leaves the stage at Joining so the retry redoes it.

title: CreateJoinAs answer is Option<Result<_,()>> in the session, consumed only by a waiting box
trigger: Start video chat in a group, then close the 'Start' box (or switch chat) before getUserAvailableParticipants answers; or the request is dropped without an answer/error
effect: The answer stays in calls.create_join_as until the next request overwrites it; if no answer or error ever arrives the box sits in CreateStep::Waiting with no way out except the user cancelling. In-flight, answered and failed are one Option<Result> plus a separate failed_creates side list
fix: Make the create flow one enum on the box (Asking(request) / Answered(list) / Failed) owned by GroupCallCreate via the Asker seam, so closing the box drops the request and an answer is matched to it; remove the session-level create_join_as.

title: X11 record thread can end while the Controller still reports Active
trigger: Joined with push-to-talk on under X11; the record data connection errors (X server restart, reply Err) or record_enable_context fails in the thread; thread returns without telling anyone.
effect: Handle is still held by Controller (HookState::Active, status note 'Works system-wide'), but no key edges ever arrive: system-wide push-to-talk silently stops until the call or setting changes. If the key was down at that moment the microphone stays open (see key filter entry).
fix: Hook thread reports its end through the Sink or a shared HookLife enum (Running/Ended(reason)); Controller.sync treats an ended handle as Failed and restarts or surfaces it.

title: Playback watch falls back only once, even when the reopen failed
trigger: Watch a live stream whose output device vanishes; observe() returns OutputFailed and sets fell_back; reopen_stream_sound fails (device not back yet, stream.rs:251).
effect: fell_back is never cleared (entry removed only when the feeder closes), so the stream stays silent for the rest of the call with no further retry, though the device may return.
fix: enum WatchStage { Watching{live_since}, Reopened{attempts}, GaveUp } reset by the driver when reopen returns Ok or a new output is built.

title: Level tap error closes the source but leaves 'speaking' true and never sends is_speaking=false
trigger: Join a group call, unmute and talk, then unplug or lose the microphone so source.error() returns Some
effect: pump_call_audio closes the tap and returns early; speaking and the tracker are not reset, deadline() returns None (no source), and the open retry path (line 344) returns Ok(false) too, so the self tile keeps showing 'speaking' and TDLib is never told false until a reopen succeeds or the call is muted
fix: Route the error arm through the same 'cannot speak' teardown as the wanted==None arm (reset tracker, send false), or make the tap one enum (Closed, Opening, Open{speaking}, Failed{at,error}).

title: Share wanted and source chosen but no frame sender: stays 'sharing' with nothing sent and no error
trigger: Start screen share in a call whose engine is unavailable or has not created external sources (external_frame_sender returns None)
effect: pump_shared_screen returns silently every pump; the session says screen_sharing, the call window shows the share as live, but no capture is opened and call_screen.error is never set
fix: Waiting-for-engine as an explicit Share stage with a timeout/error that ends the share via stop_sharing_screen.

title: rating_sent is set before the answer and the SendCallRating error arm never clears it
trigger: End a call, rate it, TDLib sendCallRating fails (offline, flood)
effect: summary.rating_sent stays true so the rating card is gone (call_ui hides on rating_sent) and send_call_rating refuses; only a calls.error line shows; the rating cannot be retried
fix: Rating as enum Rating{Asking, Sending(RequestId), Sent}; the error arm returns to Asking (as SendCallLog does for log_sent).

title: Stopping a screen share clears the local flags before TDLib answers endGroupCallScreenSharing
trigger: Stop sharing while the end request fails (flood, call already gone)
effect: UI shows not sharing and the native presentation is stopped, while the server may still list the screen as shared; no way back into the Sharing state
fix: ScreenShare::Stopping(request) that becomes Idle on ok and Sharing/Failed on error.

title: Self mute flag is flipped locally but Telegram is told only when your own participant row exists
trigger: Mute or unmute right after joining, before the participant list contains the current user
effect: is_muted_self changes and the engine follows, but toggleGroupCallParticipantIsMuted is never sent; other participants keep the old icon and the next server row can flip the button back
fix: Keep an intended-mute value to send once the row arrives, or send it by group call id for self.

title: call_link_after_leave is never cleared on a failed leave, a cancel, a new call or an account switch
trigger: In a call, open a voice chat link, confirm 'End call and join'. discard_call/leave_group_call errors are discarded (`let _ =`) so the call stays up (network down). Keep using the app; later hang up the call normally.
effect: maybe_offer_pending_call_link runs from ingest once no call is on and silently offers/fetches the old link's call, opening a join screen the user abandoned long ago; nothing else ever clears the Option.
fix: Fold call_link/call_link_confirm/call_link_after_leave into one CallLinkStage enum (Idle, Asking(confirm), Leaving{chat,hash,since_call}, Offered(link)) whose Leaving arm exits on the leave error, on a different call starting, and in CallBoxes::farewell.

title: Link confirmed after leaving a call loses live_stream and the stream join intent
trigger: In a voice chat, open a channel live stream link (?livestream=), confirm 'Leave and join live stream'. call_link_after_leave stores only (chat_id, hash) and maybe_offer_pending_call_link calls offer_call_link(.., false).
effect: The UI path (ui/call_link_ui.rs offer_call_link) that calls note_stream_join_intent(StreamJoinIntent::Call) and shows 'Opening the live stream' is skipped, so the stream does not open in its window and no note shows; a repeated Busy would also word the question as a voice chat.
fix: Keep the whole CallLinkConfirm (or a LinkTarget{chat,hash,live_stream}) in the Leaving stage and report the resulting CallLinkStep back to the UI so it records the join intent.

title: extras_requested is set before the three live-story requests; a send failure aborts the rest and an error answer is never retried
trigger: Watch a non-stream live story; getLiveStoryStreamer errors or its send fails
effect: streamer stays None for the whole watch, so live_story_live_key returns None and no picture is drawn; top donors/senders may never load; only reopening the story retries
fix: Three Fetch<T> fields on LiveStoryState, requested while Idle, retried from Failed on a user action.

title: A failing connect_group_call is retried after every reducer update because join_payload stays set while transport_ready is false
trigger: Join a call where the engine rejects the join answer (bad device, engine error); any group-call update then arrives
effect: pump_group_call_transport calls pump_one_group_call per update, which re-runs refresh_call_devices, connect_group_call and note_stream_rtmp_info each time; you stay joined on the server with no media and no leave
fix: Transport::Failed(err) consumes the payload; only a rejoin or the Join button starts a new attempt.

title: A failed presentation connect clears the local screen-share flags but never ends the screen share TDLib already started
trigger: Start screen share in a joined group call; startGroupCallScreenSharing answers, then engine.connect_screen_share fails
effect: Quill shows not sharing (and stops the native presentation) while other participants still see you as sharing a dead screen; no endGroupCallScreenSharing is sent
fix: One ScreenShare enum (Idle, Offering, Answered, Sharing, Failed) whose Failed exit sends endGroupCallScreenSharing.

title: A stream reply of Left stops the transport and clears the payload but starts no rejoin and leaves the call tracked and joined
trigger: A stream part request answers GROUP_CALL_LEFT while TDLib still reports the call joined
effect: No media and no automatic recovery; transport_ready false, join_payload empty, so neither the connect pump nor auto rejoin acts until an updateGroupCall
fix: Route Left through rejoin.want() or a Transport::Lost variant the UI shows with Rejoin.

title: A failed call rating is marked sent and the rating card is dismissed
trigger: Rate a call from the end screen while the sendCallRating request fails (flood wait, offline)
effect: send_call_rating sets rating_sent=true after the send; the SendCallRating error arm (domains/calls/error.rs) only sets calls.error and never clears rating_sent, so the card is gone and the rating is lost with only a status line; the UI note said Thanks for your feedback because the send itself returned Ok
fix: Upload enum with Sending then Sent on ok or Failed on error, keyed by the request id; show the card again on Failed.

title: A failed busy-decline or swap-prompt decline shows 'Could not hang up the call' on the active call
trigger: In a call, a second caller rings and is declined as busy (or the swap prompt's Decline is used); the caller already cancelled so discardCall errors (e.g. 400)
effect: The error banner 'Could not hang up the call' appears on the ongoing call's overlay although nothing about that call failed. All three discardCall senders use the same RequestPurpose::DiscardCall and the arm sets calls.error whenever hang_up does not match
fix: Give the decline discard its own purpose (DeclineCall{call_id}) and set calls.error only for the request that owns HangUp

title: Settings > Calls spawns a fetch and notifies every frame while the sessions list stays idle
trigger: Open Settings > Calls while the session is not Authorization Ready or ShutdownPhase is not Running (for example while logging out, or the first moments after a reconnect), or while send_json fails. call_device_prefs_section runs in render; sessions.is_idle() is true, so it spawn_screen's a task that calls maybe_fetch_active_sessions (returns Err(InvalidRequest) before sessions.begin(), so the state stays Idle) and then cx.notify()s unconditionally when live is Some. The notify re-renders the section, which spawns again.
effect: A redraw plus task-spawn loop at frame rate for as long as the page is open and the fetch cannot start; CPU/battery drain.
fix: Start the fetch from upkeep keyed on the Fetch state (Idle -> Loading) and notify only when the request was actually sent (Ok(Some(_))); never notify from a no-op.

title: A failed call-window open is retried by every frame and posts its error each time
trigger: A call rings in (or is placed) and cx.open_window fails (display gone, OS refusal). open_call_window clears calls.window_opening and sets the 'Couldn't open the call window' note, but sets nothing that stops sync_call_window: wanted stays Some(id) with calls.window None, so the next sync_call_windows (the poll and every window's frame; the note/notify re-renders) calls open_call_window again.
effect: A loop of open attempts and repeated error toasts (a request/redraw loop) for the length of the call.
fix: Make the call window one enum (Closed, Opening, Open(handle), Failed(call_id)) so a failure records the call it failed for and sync does not retry until the call changes.

title: A failed sendCallRating still shows Thanks for your feedback
trigger: End a call, rate it and Submit while the request fails (flood, network error).
effect: send_call_rating sets rating_sent=true before the answer; apply_calls_error for SendCallRating sets only calls.error and never reverts rating_sent. The card shows Thanks, the rating was lost, and the error appears only after the card is dismissed (the summary branch does not draw it). Debug upload and log reset their sent flag on error, the rating does not.
fix: Per-upload enum NotNeeded/Offer/Sending{request}/Sent/Failed(err); rating moves Sending to Sent only on ok and to Failed on error.

title: redial dismisses the end summary before the offline check
trigger: Go offline, end a call whose summary offers a rating or diagnostics upload, press Call again in the call window or end card.
effect: The summary (rating prompt, upload buttons) is dropped, the call is refused with the offline note, so the rating can no longer be given. redial and call_again also skip refuse_without_call_engine and end in a generic Could not start the call.
fix: Run the offline and engine checks first and dismiss the summary only once the dial is accepted.

title: Dial answer not matched to the dial that asked: one shared dialing slot read by a generic continuation
trigger: Place a voice call to A while the microphone prompt is open (access Undetermined), then press video call to B (dialing is overwritten with (B,true)). Grant the microphone: the first continuation re-checks only the microphone, passes, and dial_allowed takes (B,true).
effect: A video call to B is sent although camera access was never granted or was still being asked, and A is never called. After a denied prompt dialing also stays Some with nothing to clear it.
fix: Carry (user_id,is_video) inside the continuation (or a DialStage enum Idle/AwaitingAccess{request}/Sent with a request token) and clear it on the denied arm and on cancel; do not read a shared slot from a generic callback.

title: A failed call window open re-notes the error on every sync
trigger: Join a voice chat on a platform/state where cx.open_window returns Err; sync_call_windows runs every frame/poll, window stays None while the call is wanted, so open_group_call_window runs again
effect: The 'could not open the video chat' note is raised again and again, and an open attempt is made on every sync
fix: Make the window one enum (Closed, Opening, Open(handle), Failed(call id)) so a failed open for a call is remembered and not retried until the call changes.
